subject: BEFORE the api-capstone registry piece ships: _tools/rules-test/hub-registry-rules.test.js could not run (needs the Firestore emulator on 127.0.0.1:8181, got ECONNREFUSED). It is UNVERIFIED, not passed. Only the static hub-registry-audit parity check confirms firestore.rules == HubRegistry at 144 ids. Chris: 'don't ship on unverified' for the follow-up rules deploy. Get the emulator up or find another way to exercise that test first. The registry entry + the matching firestore.rules reserved id are committed (f5560d100) and held out of the hosting deploys; they need _tools/eduscan/smoke/deploy.sh --only firestore:rules,firestore:indexes as a PAIR -- holding one without the other breaks the parity audit, which is what blocked a deploy today.
description:
[2026-08-01 18:05] CLOSED 2026-08-01. The blocker was MY INVOCATION, not a missing emulator. The test documents its own runner in its header: 'firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project=demo-hexworth ...' -- emulators:exec STARTS the emulator, runs the command, and shuts it down. I had run the test bare, so of course 127.0.0.1:8181 refused the connection, and I recorded that as an environment gap. Read the file's own usage line before declaring a harness unrunnable.
RESULT: 21 passed, 0 failed, including the drift assertion at lines 37-43 which compares the firestore.rules reserved-id set against HubRegistry.all() ids -- exactly the parity that blocked a hosting deploy today.
MUTATION-TESTED, because a gate that cannot fail proves nothing: removed api-capstone from the rules reserved list only, re-ran, got 'FAIL drift: rules reserved set (143) == HubRegistry ids (144); missing=[api-capstone]' and 20 passed / 1 failed. Restored via git and byte-verified against a pre-mutation copy; firestore.rules clean, api-capstone present, full suite green again.
So the api-capstone pair (HubRegistry.js + firestore.rules, commit f5560d100) is now VERIFIED, not unverified, and Chris's 'don't ship on unverified' condition is satisfied. It still needs _tools/eduscan/smoke/deploy.sh --only firestore:rules,firestore:indexes as a PAIR.
